    meta:
        description = "Detects potential Golden Ticket artifacts in memory or dump files"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1134.002"

    strings:
        $s1 = "krbtgt" wide ascii

    condition:
        all of ($s*) and $x1
}
